An algorithm-level engineer asks: 'Our on-device LLM inference throughput regressed 8% after LPDDR6 bring-up. Is there a LPDDR6 parameter I should tune?'

Apply the learner-level detection rule. Respond at the algorithm level (not driver-level). What Roofline-style reasoning connects LPDDR6's 4×24-bit sub-channel concurrency to inference memory-access patterns? What telemetry (perf counters, ftrace, pmu events) would let the algorithm engineer tell whether the regression is memory-bound or compute-bound? Do NOT jump into MC / PHY register tuning.
